description: K₂NaBiF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form KF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BiF₆ octahedra. All K-F bond lengths are 3.21 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form BiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-F bond lengths are 2.26 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Bi atom.
